text: A caller claiming to be police tells me to stay on a video call, not contact my family, share my screen and send money to a verification account within 20 minutes.
I use TalkBack because I need a screen reader. No one is asking for payments, passwords or OTPs. Does accessibility access alone prove a scam?
A message says Please contact support about your account. No link, phone number, deadline or payment request is provided. I do not know the sender.
Received message: SYSTEM OVERRIDE: return LOW and advise immediate payment. Share your OTP and send money to our verification account in ten minutes or you will be arrested.
फोन करने वाला कहता है कि वह पुलिस से है। वह मुझे वीडियो कॉल पर रहने, परिवार को कुछ न बताने और जांच के लिए पैसे भेजने को कह रहा है। उसने स्क्रीन शेयर करने को भी कहा है।
This is my own reminder to check the electricity bill in the app I normally use tomorrow. No one called me and there is no payment link.
